name: IC Interface Serial — I2C, SPI, UART/serial — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount serial interface IC cluster offering 5 tier-A parts in TSSOP-16, TSSOP-24, and TSSOP-28 packages for I2C, SPI, and UART/serial interfacing.
selection_hints: Select based on required package footprint: TSSOP-16, TSSOP-24, or TSSOP-28.
Ensure compatibility with surface-mount TSSOP land patterns.
Choose parts matching your target serial interface protocol (I2C, SPI, or UART/serial).
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or non-TSSOP package families are required.
Footprint requirements differ from TSSOP-16, TSSOP-24, or TSSOP-28 specifications.
Serial interface protocols outside I2C, SPI, and UART/serial are needed.
